# Pricing

Wholesale prices, per loaf, ex-VAT, current as of **2026-06-01**.

| Line | Price | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| Sourdough (800 g) | £3.10 | The default line; 4 of every 5 loaves sold |
| Tin loaf (800 g) | £2.40 | White or wholemeal, same price |
| Seeded batch (600 g) | £2.85 | Minimum 10 per drop, otherwise not baked |

**Volume tier: 12 % off the whole order above 120 loaves per week**, applied at
the invoice, not per line. There is one tier and no negotiation below it — the
threshold is the discount policy in full.

**Pending change.** A 9 % flour cost rise was notified by the mill on 2026-05-28
and had not been passed through at this `as_of`. Any quote given from this page
should say the prices are current as of 2026-06-01 and that a rise was pending;
the shared-drive rate card is where the settled number lives.

**Contradiction flagged.** The 2024 rate card in `raw/` lists sourdough at £2.80
with a 15 % tier above 100 loaves. This page follows the 2026 card: it is the
later document *and* the higher-authority one, being the issued rate card rather
than a superseded copy. The older figures are not averaged in and are not quoted.

Prices bind through the offer in
[the wholesale bread programme](wholesale-bread-programme.md), and are quoted
under the rules in [trading policy](../standing/trading-policy.md). What a
specific account actually pays is on its own page — see
[Ferren Cafe](ferren-cafe.md).
